title: fix(app-shell,plugin-list,i18n): list empty states match the page they sit on (objectui#11687)
body:
Fixes #11687

Clause-②: yes

Implemented by the os-dev agent dispatched from seat `domain:ui#1`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`, under the claim on the card (comment 6017757987).

## What was wrong

The two empty-state defects measured on the console (objectui#11672, item 15):

1. Invitations and OAuth Applications said "These records are created by the authentication provider … not added by hand here." beside an "Invite User" / "Register OAuth Application" button.
2. Webhooks' Active view, zero rows, said "No records match your current filters or search." with no filter or search applied.

## Mechanism, measured against the PM's hypotheses

- **H1 holds.** The `better-auth` arm of `resolveManagedByEmptyState` returned the identity copy for every object except `sys_user` / `sys_team`, without asking anything about the page. The `engine-owned` arm already yields when the `create` affordance is open.
- **H2 holds, and it chose the predicate.** Both buttons are object actions placed at `list_toolbar`. They are not the CRUD `create` affordance: `sys_invitation` and `sys_oauth_application` leave `create` at the bucket default, which is off. Their gates reach the client already lowered into `visible` (`requiresFeature` and `requiresMembershipReach`), so whether the button is on the page depends on the deployment and the caller. A predicate on `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances` alone would have left both pages broken while the tests passed. Only `create_oauth_application` declares `mode: 'create'`. `invite_user` declares no mode, so a `mode`-based predicate would also have missed Invitations.
- **H3 holds and is kept.** The view's own `filter` still counts as a query, for objectui#4155's reason: a list emptied by its view filter must not get the first-run copy.
- **H4 is partly falsified: the API Keys page offers no create action.** `sys_api_key` declares no `list_toolbar` action and keeps `create` at the bucket default. Keys are minted through `POST /api/v1/keys`. This holds at the dogfood's framework commit `ce577ec4` and at objectstack `aa09db58`. The sweep's sentence put three pages under two button names. API Keys is therefore pinned as the page whose identity copy stays.

## The change

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`:** `ObjectView` computes `pageOffersCreate`. It is true when the page's New button shows (`objectCanCreate && createVisible`) or when the toolbar draws a `list_toolbar` action. The toolbar half is the new `listToolbarDrawsAction` in `utils/managedByEmptyState.ts`. It asks the same three questions `action:bar` and then `action:button` ask: `actionRendersAt(action, 'list_toolbar')`, the `useCapabilityGate` closure, and the `visible` gate. The gate goes through `hasDeclaredPredicate` and is evaluated fail-closed with no row bound. `resolveManagedByEmptyState` takes the boolean as a fifth argument. In the `better-auth` arm, a page that offers a create action falls back to the list's own empty-state copy. `sys_team` keeps its copy, which already names its Create Team button, and stays ahead of the check. The package entry exports neither function, so the signature change does not reach the published surface.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list`:** `ListView` now chooses its empty-state message three ways:
  - a user query (search box, user-filter chips or filter panel) keeps `list.noMatchesMessage`;
  - the view's own filter alone gets the new `list.viewFilterNoMatchesMessage`, "No records match this view’s filter.", under the existing "No matching records" title;
  - neither gets the first-run copy.

  The key is also in `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** `list.viewFilterNoMatchesMessage` is added to all ten packs.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/11687-empty-state-copy-matches-page.md`: `minor` for i18n and plugin-list, whose published surface grows, and `patch` for app-shell.

## Pins: the four measured pages

`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.emptyStateMatchesPage-11687.test.tsx` mounts the real `ObjectView` and the real `ListView` inside a real i18next instance booted in en. Each object is in its served shape, with gates already lowered:

- **Invitations** (Pending view, multi-org, org admin): Invite User is drawn. The empty state has no identity copy and says "No records match this view’s filter."
- **Invitations, single-org** (control): Invite User is hidden by its own gate, so the identity copy stays.
- **API Keys** (`all_keys`): the page offers no create action, so the identity copy stays.
- **OAuth Applications** (`all_apps`): Register OAuth Application is drawn, and the list shows the first-run copy.
- **Webhooks, Active view:** "No matching records" with "No records match this view’s filter.", and no "your current filters or search".

Also added: unit cases in `managedByEmptyState.test.ts` (the resolver and `listToolbarDrawsAction`) and three cases in `ListView.emptyStateFilteredCopy.test.tsx` (view filter only; a typed search; a user filter over a filtered view).

## Reverse verification

These were one-off runs; each direction was predicted before running. Each leg changed the committed fix through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob changed. The leg then ran the suites and restored the file, proven by `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Tests resolve `@object-ui/*` to `src` through the root vitest alias, so no rebuild was needed.

- **A.** The `pageOffersCreate` check removed: 4 failed, 29 passed. The two resolver unit cases, Invitations and OAuth failed. Both controls and Webhooks stayed green.
- **B.** The two-way `hasActiveQuery` message choice restored: 3 failed, 30 passed. The ListView view-filter case, Invitations and Webhooks failed.
- **C.** `listToolbarDrawsAction` no longer reads `visible`: 3 failed, 23 passed across two suites. The two gate unit cases and the single-org control failed.

## Local verification at `0ef8b17`

- Build: the dependency closure, `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter '@object-ui/i18n^...' build`, exited 0 (29 of 47 workspace projects).
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: all exit 0. Each script ran as `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and the test project includes `src/**/*.test.ts(x)`.
- `test`, i18n: 80 files, 1304 passed and 13 skipped. plugin-list: 113 files, 1224 passed. app-shell: 1032 files passed and 1 skipped, 10181 tests passed and 9 skipped.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report only; the new key is not a candidate), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, and the changeset presence, no-major, fixed and overwrite scripts: all exit 0.
- Not measured: `check:eager-locale-catalogues`. It printed `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` because it needs a built console bundle. That run belongs to CI.
- ESLint was narrowed to the 16 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (the `--format json` count) and found 0 errors. The 366 warnings are pre-existing rules on `ObjectView.tsx` / `ListView.tsx`; none is on an added line. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes (observations; none filed)

- **The identity copy still outranks a user query.** `ListView` reads `schema.emptyState` before its own choice, and the objectui#4155 pin "the author's own emptyState copy still wins over both" holds that order. On a `better-auth` list whose page offers no create action, such as API Keys or single-org Invitations, a search that matches nothing therefore shows "No identity records" rather than "No matching records". This comes from reading the source; it was not measured in the running app. Carrier: none.
- **Default-on feature flags do not fail open when absent.** The spec's `featureGatePredicate` doc says a default-on flag fails open when it is absent ("e.g. config not yet fetched"). Measured here: `features.organization != false` evaluated against `features: {}` throws in objectui's CEL evaluator, and the fail-closed `visible` hides the action. The server may always report every flag, so this was not measured in the running app. Seam: `spec:featureGatePredicate → renderer:action-button`. Carrier: none.
- **API Keys copy is inaccurate.** The identity copy says API Keys rows arrive "through sign-in, provisioning, and security flows", but users mint keys themselves on the Connect an Agent page. This is copy polish outside this card.
- **The Teams copy names a button that can be hidden.** `sys_team`'s copy names "Create Team" even where that action is hidden: its gate is the organization feature plus owner/admin reach. This predates the PR and is unchanged.
- **Deep-link filters count as the view's filter.** `ObjectView` folds URL filters (`?filter=` deep links) into the view's `filter`, so an empty deep-linked list now reads the view-filter message.
- **No docs change.** No page under `content/docs`, and none of the three package READMEs, describes how the list chooses its empty state.
